answer: Willow-pair receipt bond: each identity files two linked receipts per epoch — a willow receipt proving one task and a jetty receipt proving the fee. Both are key-signed, hash-linked in the public karst ledger, and replayed by auditors. A rented receipt breaks the link, burning the 70-credit bond. 1,000 fakes pay 1,000 × 115 = 115,000 credits (70 bond + 45 filing) vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent files one pair, pays 45 once, keeps its bond.
